browser.methodology: Three serial runs of unchanged production3.0 living browser script after all repository tests finished, installed Chrome on same machine. Quantiles summarize real handler timings (excludes paint/network); median of three per-run p95s, not pooled percentile. FCP is local production serve.

traceMethodology: Legal deterministic policies, 3 styles × seeds2026/91373 from disadvantaged restart. Click proxies count resolver invocations, not observed human UI clicks. Major-decision classification is explicitly the listed regular expression; automated action repetition is not itself proof of human friction. Timing intentionally excluded while repository gates run.

routine.methodology: Existing3.0 weekly routine retail life; public actions only. Outer commands approximate action-button activations, not measured human UI navigation. Inner executed routine actions counted separately. This is not the same workload or target as manual career-change/social/enterprise policies.

environment.methodology: 31 samples after3 warmups per API, measured after each life so microbenchmarks do not inflate simulation time. Node wall-clock; excludes browser paint/network. Simulation timings include action selection, strict validation, input immutability checks and periodic GC. Retained heap includes the test action trace and up to4 serialized checkpoints; it is not peak memory. Compressed sizes use local gzip, not a network transfer claim.

uiFriction.method: Real DOM clicks in fresh contexts, authoritative read-only inspection. Counts are clicks and changed select values, not action-trace commands. Auto-scroll is recorded as target distance, not claimed as human gestures.
